codeFindings.finding: Actual groups/list GET hooks pass query strings and no explicit queuePriority; default classifier returns normal. New landing page P0 can miss reserved critical slot.
/api/v1/conversations/groups matches generic single-segment conversation_detail classifier; no separate fixed groups branch.
Queue duration only recorded after dispatchedAt exists; queue-expired requests have no stage measurement.
Socket close aborts controller; generic catch rethrows. Fixed-window AbortError sample stack points to onClose.
Unconditional crypto.randomUUID call on new-draft initialization; C8 confirms unavailable browser API, exact minified call is not source-mapped.
Client receipt deadline is 3 seconds including queue, while identity can take up to 5 seconds and report RPC has a separate 3-second timeout.

limitations: Only sanitized aggregates, code facts and event/trace references saved; no raw logs, business identities, request bodies, credentials or Replay.
The two paired startup examples prove their own redirect/pre-fetch delay, not a causal allocation of all 434 stalls.
Stage P95 distributions are independent and success-only; never added or subtracted to assign durations. Expired queues are absent from queue-stage measurements.
Abort-on-close origin is confirmed for sampled events; initiating cause may be user navigation, client deadline or connection loss.
PostgREST deadlines are observed, but database SQL execution/lock/pool/physical network causes remain unproven without deeper correlated evidence.
Commit ancestry alone is insufficient under squash; deployed file contents and reachable release commits were checked.
All 229 fixed-window Sentry error/fatal events are tagged release 47414e2f; this does not prove complete visibility of all visits.

traceAvailability.note: Resource summaries returned no spans; not evidence that real requests had no work.
